alt_text_en: A red panda studies at a cozy desk while the real focus timer shows 25 minutes.
Choose a red panda, penguin, sea otter, squirrel or fennec fox. Each friend has a different room.
Four real app screens show the same red panda desk in morning, daytime, evening and night light.
The Focus sounds panel offers rain, forest and fire sounds, a volume slider and automatic stop at the end of focus.
Example focus records for October 2026 show a calendar with red panda stamps on the days focused, through October 16.
The Collected items screen shows a little plant, warm mug and cozy lamp unlocked by completing focus sessions.
